about: Sound set for the game (install.py puts the picks from picks.json into public/). Loudness = K-weighted, ungated, whole clip (lib/dsp.py lufs).

jump.event: Hop to the top lane (every jump)

hop-land.event: Hop landing, back on the floor (new, no sound today)

heartbeat.event: Death replay heartbeat (loops; the old death sound ran at half speed)

onion.event: Onion obstacle on screen (new, no sound today)

holy-choir.event: "Pope" obstacle on screen: neutral synthetic holy choir sting

apple.event: Pick up an apple (also the combo chime base)

beer.event: Pick up a beer (6 flavours can share these 3)

burp.event: Burp (after a beer; Eksterminator's last puff borrows it)

combo-tick.event: Combo tick, 8 rising pitches (one per combo step)

combo-break.event: Big combo shattered (bigger sibling of combo-lost, new)

boss-gun.event: Gun shot (pistol; boss shots + VS screen)

vs-slam-1.event: VS screen: first portrait slams in

vs-slam-2.event: VS screen: second portrait slams in

ability-reward.event: Ability reward fanfare (icon lands + title slam)

lodzia-boomerang.event: Slipper ricochets back like a boomerang

lodzia-smack.event: Slipper smacks her in the face

boss-parry.event: The roach parries: a shot or a thrown thing deflected back (Eksterminator, Bigos, Zlewiatan)

ex-knock.event: His wand knocked out of his hand by the lunge

ex-shove.event: Shoved reeling back by the lunge or a crash

ex-struck.event: The roach is struck by his gas or jet

ex-mine-arm.event: A mine arms and starts to gas

ex-leak.event: The tank leaks, whistling higher each rage step (played at rising rate)

ex-rush.event: The charge passes along a lane

bigos-shriek.event: A speaker shrieks with feedback (played at 1.6x rate)

bigos-defeat.event: DJ Bigos is defeated: the deck winds down

zl-head-fall.event: A head wrenches off its pipe and falls

zl-head-bounce.event: The loose head lands, bounces and rolls

zl-head-smash.event: A head smashed (loose head dashed, or a head smacked by what was sent back)

centipede-rear.event: Centipede rears with a hiss, then scuttles

aerosol-rattle.event: Aerosol can shot: rattles before it blows

repeller-ring.event: Repeller sends a ring down the lane

spraywall-puff.event: Spray can shakes and puffs its cloud wall

robovac-crack.event: Robot vacuum cracks under the first shot

boss-prelude.event: Versus splash: tense pre-battle loop (every boss)

current.note: current: the level's music keeps playing

boss-aftermath.event: Ability screen after a boss: calm relieved loop

current.note: current: the boss's own music keeps playing (Lodzia's here)
